raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19, business date 2026-01-18) delivers customer_id without zero-padding (e.g. 'C2', 'C139' instead of 'C00002', 'C00139'), so those transactions fail the join to the customer dimension. This drops 344 POSTED rows from gold_region_daily (4699 - 4355) and splits customers in gold_customer_spend. The fix normalizes unpadded IDs back to the canonical 'C' plus 5-digit format in silver_transactions.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]{1,4}$') THEN 'C' || lpad(substr(customer_id, 2), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
